t: Ewropej: EP news at your fingertips
html:
Corporate Identities teamed up with LovinMalta and MaltaToday to bring the latest European Parliament news at your fingertips over 2021 and 2022.

The aim is was to bring Brussels closer to the Maltese people, keeping the general public informed on the Parliamentary decisions that affect you.

From plastic, to work and internet use, the European Parliament is set to take big decisions that will impact our day-to-day lives. This initiative will keep you up to date on all the latest news that you need to know.

It spanned several mediums: from radio, to video, to online news and print.

As this project comes to an end, we are committed to continue reporting on EU matters as we believe EU membership has been instrumental for Malta. This became clear during the Covid-19 pandemic, where Malta was able to be access vaccines more easily because of EU membership. Maltese representation has recently achieved new heights, after MEP Roberta Metsola was elected as First Vice-President of the European Parliament.

For all the latest EU updates, visit our Comuniq.ue section

This article is part of a content series called Ewropej. This is a multi-newsroom initiative part-funded by the European Parliament to bring the work of the EP closer to the citizens of Malta and keep them informed about matters that affect their daily lives. This article reflects only the author’s view. The European Parliament is not responsible for any use that may be made of the information it contains.
